data.narrative:
ideaForge is a public-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $50M+. The valuation analysis drew from a peer universe of 7 private companies in the same sector, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in the narrow Drones & Autonomous category.

The peer-median triangulation method was not applicable to this analysis. The sector contains only 5 same-sector peers total, with insufficient clustering at the same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier to generate a reliable median. Specifically, only 2 same-stage peers were identified, 0 adjacent-stage, and 0 similar-tier comparables—falling short of the minimum 3-datapoint threshold required for statistical validity. Attempting to broaden to an all-sector median would introduce excessive heterogeneity and mask material differences in technology maturity, market focus, and capital intensity across the drone and autonomous systems landscape.

Given the structural absence of a sufficient narrow peer set, this valuation cannot be triangulated using comparable-company methodology at this time. Credible analysis would require either (1) expansion of the peer universe through identification of adjacent sectors (e.g., robotics, aerospace) with comparable unit economics and customer concentration, or (2) deployment of alternative methods such as DCF or precedent transaction analysis using disclosed financing rounds within the identified peer set.
